sub_limits_waiting_notes: Morbid obesity: 36 months. Correction of refractive error: 24 months. Infertility: 24 months continuous coverage. Mental Illnesses Depression and Schizophrenia: 2 years.

inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Reasonable and Customary Charges; Plan A has per-day caps for room/ICU

day_care_treatments.notes: Less than 24 hours at Hospital/Day Care Centre

domiciliary_treatment.limit_text: Up to limit shown in Table of Benefits
domiciliary_treatment.notes: Excludes treatments <3 days, alternative treatment, maternity/infertility, asthma/bronchitis/epilepsy/etc.

ayush_coverage.notes: In-patient Care under Ayurveda/Yoga/Naturopathy/Unani/Siddha/Homeopathy at AYUSH Hospital

maternity_coverage.notes: 24-month continuous coverage required; covered age 18-45; max 2 deliveries/terminations lifetime

newborn_coverage.limit_text: Auto-covered for 3 months from birth under mother's SI

organ_donor_expenses.notes: Per Transplantation of Human Organs Act 1994

restoration_benefit.notes: Once per policy year, after RTA-related exhaustion

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: End of every block of two continuous policy years
preventive_health_checkup.notes: Subject to continuous renewal without break

room_rent_capping: Plan A only: per-day limit as Table of Benefits; Plan B and C: higher caps. No cap if PPN packaged listed procedure.
icu_capping: Plan A only: per-day limit as Table of Benefits; Plan B/C: higher caps. No cap in PPN packaged procedure.
copayment_trigger_notes: Optional Co-payment: 20% with 25% discount or 10% with 12.5% discount.

disease_wise_sub_limits.cataract: Plan A only - per Table of Benefits

permanent_exclusions: Rest Cure, Rehabilitation and Respite Care
Obesity/Weight Control (except morbid obesity per criteria)
temporary_exclusions: Specified diseases - 90 days/1 year/2 years/3 years
notable_exclusions_summary: Standard IRDAI exclusions plus 30-day initial wait, 36-month PED wait, 24-month wait for maternity/infertility. Treatment outside India not covered.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via TPA approval; pre-auth 1 hour, final auth 3 hours. Reimbursement: documents within 30 days of discharge. Claim decision within 15 days of last necessary document.
